transcript.en: Good morning. This is Burnham tourist office, Martin speaking.
transcript.zh: 上午好，这里是Burnham游客咨询处，我是Martin。

transcript.en: Oh, hello.I saw a poster about free things to do in the area, and it said people should phone you for information.
transcript.zh: 你好，我看到了一张海报，上面罗列了一些在这附近能进行的自由活动，海报上写着可以给你打电话询问相关信息。

transcript.en: I'm coming to Burnham with my husband and two children for a few days on June the 27th,
transcript.zh: 我和丈夫还有两个孩子六月二十七日会来Burnham玩几天，

transcript.en: or possibly the 28th, and I'd like some ideas for things to do on the 29th.
transcript.zh: 也有可能是二十八日来，所以我想知道二十九日有没有什么活动可以参加。

transcript.en: Yes, of course. OK.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题。

transcript.en: Then let's start with a couple of events especially for children.
transcript.zh: 那我先跟您介绍几个专为孩子举行的活动吧。

transcript.en: The art gallery is holding an event called 'Family Welcome' that day,
transcript.zh: 美术馆那天会举行一个叫做Family Welcome的活动，

transcript.en: when there are activities and trails to use throughout the gallery.
transcript.zh: 当天整个场馆到处都有活动和可供使用的游径。

transcript.en: That sounds interesting.
transcript.zh: 听起来很有趣。

transcript.en: What time does it start?
transcript.zh: 它几点开始？

transcript.en: The gallery opens at 10, and the 'Family Welcome' event runs from 10:30 until 2 o'clock.
transcript.zh: 美术馆10点开始营业，Family Welcome的活动从10:30持续到下午两点。

transcript.en: The gallery stays open until 5.
transcript.zh: 下午5点钟闭馆。

transcript.en: And several times during the day, they're going to show a short film that the gallery has produced.
transcript.zh: 那一天，他们会放映好几次美术馆自己制作的一部小电影。

transcript.en: It demonstrates how ceramics are made, and there'll be equipment and materials for children to have a go themselves.
transcript.zh: 这部电影会展示制作陶器的全过程，美术馆届时还会提供工具和材料，让孩子们自己试一试。

transcript.en: Last time they ran the event, there was a film about painting,
transcript.zh: 上次他们举行这种活动的时候，放映的是一部关于画画的电影，

transcript.en: which went down very well with the children, and they're now working on one about sculpture.
transcript.zh: 在孩子们中的反响非常好，这次他们制作的是关于雕刻的。

transcript.en: I like the sound of that.
transcript.zh: 听起来很棒。

transcript.en: And what other events happen in Burnham?
transcript.zh: 在Burnham还有其他活动吗？

transcript.en: Well, do you all enjoy listening to music?
transcript.zh: 你们全家都喜欢听音乐吗？

transcript.en: Oh, yes.
transcript.zh: 嗯，对。

transcript.en: Well there are several free concerts taking place at different times - one or two in the morning,
transcript.zh: 那一天不同时段会举行好几场免费的演唱会，上午有一两场，

transcript.en: the majority at lunchtime, and a couple in the evening.
transcript.zh: 大部分都在午餐时间，傍晚还有一些。

transcript.en: And they range from pop music to Latin American.
transcript.zh: 音乐种类从流行音乐到拉丁美洲音乐都有。

transcript.en: The Latin American could be fun.
transcript.zh: 拉丁美洲音乐应该很有意思，

transcript.en: What time is that?
transcript.zh: 它什么时候举行？

transcript.en: It's being repeated several times, in different places.
transcript.zh: 它会重复在不同地点表演好几次。

transcript.en: They're performing in the central library at 1 o'clock, then at 4 it's in the City Museum,
transcript.zh: 他们一点钟的时候会在中央图书馆表演，然后四点钟在城市博物馆，

transcript.en: and in the evening, at 7.30, there's a longer concert, in the theatre.
transcript.zh: 傍晚七点钟的时候在剧院会有一个时间长一点的演唱会。

transcript.en: Right. I'll suggest that to the rest of the family.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会向我们家其他人推荐这个活动的。

transcript.en: Something else you might be interested in is the boat race along the river.
transcript.zh: 另一个您也许会感兴趣的活动就是沿河举行的划船比赛。

transcript.en: Oh, yes, do tell me about that.
transcript.zh: 哦，没错，一定要跟我讲讲这个活动。

transcript.en: The race starts at Offord Marina, to the north of Burnham, and goes as far as Summer Pool.
transcript.zh: 比赛以Offord Marina为起点，一直向Burnham北部延伸，最远到Summer Pool结束。

transcript.en: The best place to watch it from is Charlesworth Bridge, though that does get rather crowded.
transcript.zh: 最好的观赛地点是Charlesworth Bridge，不过到时候那里人会特别多。

transcript.en: And who's taking part?
transcript.zh: 参赛人员都有哪些？

transcript.en: Well, local boat clubs, but the standard is very high.
transcript.zh: 都是些当地划船俱乐部的人，不过他们的水平还是非常高的。

transcript.en: One of them came first in the West of England regional championship in May this year - it was the first time a team from Burnham has won.
transcript.zh: 其中一队在今年五月举行的英格兰西部地区锦标赛中拿了第一，

transcript.en: It means that next year they'll be representing the region in the national championship.
transcript.zh: 这意味着明年他们会代表整个地区参加全国锦标赛。

transcript.en: Now I've heard something about Paxton Nature Reserve.
transcript.zh: 我听说你们这儿有个Paxton自然保护区。

transcript.en: It's a good place for spotting unusual birds, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 那是个看罕见鸟类的好地方，对吗？

transcript.en: That's right - throughout the year.
transcript.zh: 没错，全年都可以。

transcript.en: There is a lake there, as well as a river, and they provide a very attractive habitat.
transcript.zh: 那里有一个湖，还有一条河，它们构成了一个非常迷人的栖息地。

transcript.en: So it's a good idea to bring binoculars if you have them.
transcript.zh: 如果有的话，把双筒望远镜带过去就再好不过了。

transcript.en: And just at the moment you can see various flowers that are pretty unusual - the soil at Paxton isn't very common.
transcript.zh: 现在这个时节，您可以在那儿看到各种非常与众不同的花卉，因为Paxton的土质比较罕见。

transcript.en: They're looking good right now.
transcript.zh: 现在正是这些花开得正好的时候。

transcript.en: Right. My husband will be particularly interested in that.
transcript.zh: 好的，我丈夫会对这个特别感兴趣的。

transcript.en: And there's going to be a talk and slide show about mushrooms - and you'll be able to go out and pick some afterwards and study the different varieties.
transcript.zh: 而且那里还会举办一个关于蘑菇的讲座和幻灯片放映，你可以在结束之后去捡一些蘑菇来研究不同的种类。

transcript.en: Uhuh. And is it possible for children to swim in the river?
transcript.zh: 嗯，孩子们可以在那条河里游泳吗？

transcript.en: Yes. Part of it has been fenced off to make it safe for children to swim in.
transcript.zh: 可以，为了让孩子们能在其中安全地游泳，那条河的部分流域已经用篱笆隔开了。

transcript.en: It's very shallow, and there's a lifeguard on duty whenever it's open.
transcript.zh: 河水很浅，而且对外开放的所有时间都有救生员当值。

transcript.en: The lake is too deep, so swimming isn't allowed there.
transcript.zh: 湖水的水位太深了，所以禁止在那游泳。

transcript.en: OK, we must remember to bring their swimming things, in case we go to Paxton.
transcript.zh: 好的，说不定我们会去Paxton，所以我们一定会记得带上孩子们的游泳装备的。

transcript.en: How long does it take to get there by car from Burnham?
transcript.zh: 从Burnham开车去那里要多长时间？

transcript.en: About 20 minutes, but parking is very limited, so it's usually much easier to go by bus - and it takes about the same time.
transcript.zh: 大概20分钟，不过那里的停车位非常有限，所以通常坐公共汽车去会方便很多，

transcript.en: and it takes about the same time.
transcript.zh: 而且路上花的时间差不多是一样的。

transcript.en: Right. Well, I'll discuss the options with the rest of the family.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会跟家人讨论一下这些选择的。

transcript.en: Thanks very much for all your help.
transcript.zh: 多谢你的帮助。

transcript.en: You're welcome.
transcript.zh: 不客气。

transcript.en: Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 再见。

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见。
